messages:
anya: quick triage — bootstrapping emberlyn-6b for eval + PTQ. upstream LICENSE says 'Research-Only v0.9' and requires attribution. unclear if derivative/quantized weights can be redistributed or hosted for customers.

sam: perf snapshot — fp16 ppx 12.4, int4 PTQ ppx 14.7. ROUGE-L down ~3.2, hallucination up ~5% on factual QA.

anya: PTQ command I used:
```bash
python quantize.py --model emberlyn-6b --method block-wise-int4 --calib-samples 1024 --out emberlyn-6b-int4.tar.gz
```

cleo: paste exact license text? headline vs clauses differ sometimes.

anya: LICENSE.txt: "Research-Only v0.9
You may use this model for internal research and evaluation. Redistribution of original or derivative model weights is prohibited without express permission. Attribution required for published results."

marta: initial read — "redistribution of original or derivative model weights is prohibited" likely blocks shipping quantized binaries to customers. legal review needed.

marta: triage q's: (1) dual-license? (2) CLA? (3) plan: hosted-only or allow Dedicated/private?

anya: (1) no dual license, single file only; (2) no CLA detected; (3) intent: hosted experiment first, several POCs want Dedicated/private deployment.

josh: ops note — serving artifact on our Dedicated disks != shipping to customer. shipping binary to on-prem = redistribution.

deploy-bot: scan result: research-only; artifact redistribution prohibited; legal approval recommended. [SB-2026-039] :warning:

marta: recommend: do NOT distribute quantized weights to customers or include in downloads. Hosting for internal eval maybe OK but confirm if API hosting counts as redistribution.

sam: product POV — we can gate in Hosted behind feature flags and avoid exposing raw weights or download links. watch attribution clause for public benchmarks.

cleo: QA will add emberlyn eval vectors and flag PTQ regressions >2%.

anya: proposed next steps: 1) legal confirm if hosting counts as redistribution; 2) freeze plans to ship artifacts externally; 3) run improved calibration PTQ and QAT to close quality gap; 4) if regression persists, request permission or drop from offerings.

marta: I'll ask legal to draft memo and suggested language to request permission from upstream. also check enterprise contract implications for mandatory attribution.

sam: can we run QAT vs PTQ quick comparison? if Hosted-only serving with QAT quality looks acceptable, that might be OK.

anya: launching QAT run now, will post to internal eval dashboard (internal link).

josh: if legal approves hosting, add a "redistribution prohibited" tag to model metadata to block downloads in Dedicated/private onboarding.

marta: noted.

anya: attaching quantized artifact to legal ticket but not sharing externally until sign-off. :thumbsup: 

deploy-bot: do not promote emberlyn-6b to public catalog until manual legal approval present in metadata.

sam: ack.

cleo: will add regression vectors by EOD.

anya: will update thread when QAT results are in (~4-6h).
